root_causes.root_cause: No OCR quality escalation path when Tesseract produces garbled/thin output from degraded source material (zero text layer, chart images, numeric-junk text layers). The pipeline correctly detects degraded text layers via garble gate, RTL reversal gate, and char-density checks, but the only OCR engine available (Tesseract via Docling) produces insufficient quality output for these document types, and no secondary recovery mechanism exists. Affects all 4 documents in this cluster.
root_causes.suggested_fix: Implement a tiered OCR escalation: when Tesseract OCR output fails garble/density checks, attempt a higher-quality OCR path (e.g., cloud OCR API with Arabic/chart specialization, or a second-pass with different Tesseract PSM modes). For chart images specifically, consider a chart-data extraction model rather than generic OCR. This is a known architectural gap tracked across RFC-028 D5, RFC-029 D4, RFC-035.

root_causes.root_cause: RTL reversal gate terminally rejects وارد 597 with no flat fallback path. validate_tree returns reason='rtl_reversal' (line 1375 helpers.py). The reconstruct_bidi_order repair at client.py:1418-1441 does not converge. The RFC-033 D8 flat-comparison reroute (client.py:1451-1475) only changes reason to 'node_count<3' when flat text is NOT reversed while tree IS -- but both paths produce reversed/garbled text from the numeric-junk source layer. Then 'rtl_reversal' hits the terminal-raise list at client.py:1992 and LowQualityTreeError is raised, preventing any artifact persistence. The flat routing whitelist at line 1709 only accepts 'node_count<3' and 'depth<2', not 'rtl_reversal'. No code change caused this -- it has been stable across runs 12-19.
root_causes.code_path: client.py::index() -> validate_tree(rtl_reversal) -> reconstruct_bidi_order(fails) -> RFC-033 D8 flat comparison(fails) -> LowQualityTreeError(rtl_reversal) at line 1997
root_causes.suggested_fix: Add 'rtl_reversal' to the flat-routing whitelist at client.py:1709 (alongside 'node_count<3' and 'depth<2') so that when RTL repair fails, the document can still be persisted via flat extraction. The flat-path garble gate at line 1747 already catches garbled flat text, so this would not silently persist garbage. For وارد 597 specifically, the underlying numeric-junk text layer also needs the TL-1 OCR escalation fix to produce usable output on either path.
